q: Did they use an external test dataset?
hint: Look whether an independent dataset was used to test the model.

q: Did the authors report whether they used an existing model or developed their own?
hint: Look at the end of the introduction, aim is often stated there.

q: Did the authors report whether their code is open source, where to find it and is the link permanent?
hint: Typically at the end of the paper, there is a section 'Coda availability' or related.
